prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / precise illustration refinement.
Edit IMAGE 1, the existing crimson warlord illustration, to correct a specific problem: the user finds the drawing style extremely busy and noisy. Create one refined, much cleaner high-end 2D semi-real fantasy splash illustration. The character must still have magnificent SSS Limited visual presence.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 = edit target; retain this exact male identity, long black hair, two crimson feather crown, black-gold dragon armor, standing pose, low-angle composition, black armored horse behind the left shoulder, huge crimson halberd in the right foreground, battlefield and black/gold/crimson color identity.
Image 2 = ONLY desired clean beautiful male face painting and controlled broad shading style. Do not copy its short haircut, outfit or background.
Image 3 = ONLY desired coherent elegant painterly finish and readable material handling. Do not copy the woman, glasses, modern costume, firearm or setting.

CHANGE THE PAINTING TREATMENT AND DETAIL HIERARCHY:
The existing result is too uniformly sharp, aggressively textured, fractured and over-ornamented. Repaint it with graceful larger shapes, broad confident painterly shadow masses, smooth nuanced tonal transitions, selective crisp edges, and unified harmonious lighting. The art should feel like a beautiful polished Korean 2D RPG splash, not a hyperreal metal engraving, not an oversharpened 3D render.
Keep the armor's majestic black/gold dragon design, but remove approximately two thirds of the tiny repetitive etching, hairline scratches, fractured gold flecks and random little spikes. Preserve a few beautifully designed dragon details on the shoulders, breastplate, belt and weapon. Make large smooth black armor plates and broad clean gold bevels clearly visible between them. Metallic shine must follow the large forms, not hundreds of unrelated glittering lines.
Face is the first focal point: elegant, adult, unmistakably handsome and masculine, strong calm expression, luminous pale warm skin, clean defined eyes with restrained crimson glow, refined smooth painterly face shading. Preserve the face identity and direction. Do not feminize or make it childlike.
Hair is a smooth flowing organic mass with a natural continuous silhouette and a few delicate strand accents. Remove the cloud of frantic flyaways. No rigid strips, sharp layered blades, staircase layers or individually outlined bundles. The horse's mane is also one flowing softer mass instead of a tangle of spikes. The two red feather plumes remain magnificent but their barbs have soft elegant grouped strokes.
The cape is one coherent sweeping crimson silhouette with large graceful folds. Remove the dozens of shredded ribbons and red slivers crossing the scene.
Halberd remains imposing, intricately designed but structurally legible: clean broad blades, bright crisp cutting edges, clearly organized black/gold head, red luminous core. Preserve its complete blade silhouette and pointed tip within the image, and the long continuous straight shaft. Keep correct natural hand grip and anatomy.
Cut the lightning and embers very substantially. Keep only a few deliberate crimson energy arcs around the weapon and one distant atmospheric lightning branch. Remove the all-over red web. Do not cover armor, face, hair or horse with effect lines.
Horse and background remain recognizable but use softer edges, lower detail and lower local contrast than the hero. Quiet atmospheric storm clouds and distant fortress silhouettes instead of a dense forest of tiny sharp banners. Strong luminous separation of hero from the background, restrained rim light and a soft readable face light.

RETAIN LUXURY AND SCALE: simplification means sophisticated art direction, not cheap flat art. Preserve richly painted volume, deep blacks, graceful gold planes, crimson fabric, enormous weapon and confident imposing character. Focus the most precise detail on face, shoulder dragon and weapon core; let supporting areas breathe.
One integrated portrait, exact 2:3 at 1024x1536 or larger, opaque RGB PNG. No text, logos, rank labels, watermarks, frame, UI or panels. No composition redesign, no additional characters, no new weapon.
